title: 第19章 定海诸天镇神水慈航痛失琉璃瓶第20章 灵宝复制得定海普贤出战对截教
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
碧游宫内，元始天尊和通天教主分别落座于殿上！
看着下方空间之中的局势，元始天尊有些得意的说道：
“这二十四颗定海神珠的确是十分强大的先天灵宝了，可惜若是能够集齐全部三十六颗，说不定可以达到极品先天灵宝，乃至先天至宝的程度！可惜，可惜啊……”
通天教主看着下方的战局表情有些阴晴不定，看起来这一局要输啊！
他也搞不懂现在这一局如何能够破解！
可是看着下方赵公明那自信满满的神色，似乎并不担心的样子？
难不成这二十四颗定海神珠还有什么隐藏能力没有施展出来的吗？
什么能力能够这么多三光神水的围堵之下反败为胜的呢？
若是正常对敌，有许多种办法可以躲避这三光神水！
可是如今只是灵宝斗法，偏偏这清净琉璃瓶可以生成三光神水，所以也不算违反规则！
通天教主的目光这时看向了林镜，刚刚就是他带着赵公明出去了一趟，回来之后就安排了让他出战！
此时此刻，林镜完全没有注意到师尊的注视！
他看着面前空间之中的清净琉璃瓶和三光神水露出了痴迷的神色！
这水看起来似乎很好喝的样子啊！真想尝尝看！
这清净琉璃瓶看起来也眉清目秀的样子，不知道有没有灵智，回头得找赵公明师兄借过来调教一下……
说起来，这清净琉璃瓶和三光神水林镜也是熟悉的不行了！
毕竟在前世的名着之中，就有着名的剧情描写嘛！
一只马喽取经途中把人参果树打倒了，被镇元大仙一阵收拾，最后还是求观音菩萨前来，用三光神水救活了人参果树！
没想到这清净琉璃瓶很快就要到他们截教的手中了，不知道这慈航道人以后叛变西方教还能不能成为菩萨，毕竟经典法宝都没有了……
大殿之上，赤精子看着已经完全落入下风的定海神珠，直接开口讥讽道：

“哼！公明师兄，此局明显胜负已分，你现在还不肯认输，莫不是舍不得这先天灵宝，想要耍赖？”
广成子也跟腔道：
“此次斗宝乃是师尊和三师伯两位圣人点头同意的，公明师兄既然输了就赶紧认了吧！要是我们阐教输了，可不会这般忸怩，灵宝大大方方就送出去了！”
截教这边，众位弟子纷纷面露难色！三霄眼见大哥吃瘪，皆怒目相视！
可是现在事实摆在这里，也的确不好反驳！
不过这时却有人大声鼓掌说道：
“好！说得好！我觉得很有道理，大家都是圣人子弟，肯定不会说话不算话的，输了肯定就大大方方把灵宝交出来！”
此言一出，众仙纷纷将目光都转去，却没想到说出此言竟然就是赵公明！
阐教几人明显一愣，不过反应过来之后，还是大喜过望！
本来他们还担心这赵公明不讲理耍赖，不肯交出灵宝，没想到他自己竟然会这么想！
看来这截教也不全都是不修德行之辈啊，还是有好人的！
慈航道人这时也松了口气，这清净琉璃瓶的三光神水大部分都是师尊提前赐予的，属于她的很少，所以每消耗一滴她都十分心痛！
要是这赵公明还要负隅反抗的话，不仅她会损失惨重，这二十四颗定海神珠恐怕也会受损不少！
现在的慈航道人已经把这二十四颗定海神珠视为囊中之物了，她可舍不得伤害到自己的灵宝！
这时，赵公明看着慈航道人有些忧伤的说道：
“既然胜负已分，此局也就这样吧！慈航道友，你们阐教接下来的斗宝应该也会愿赌服输的吧！”
慈航道人还没有开口，赤精子就迫不及待的抢答道：
“那当然，我们要是斗宝败了，当场就会把灵宝交出来，绝对不会拖延半分！”
赵公明的眼神向几位昆仑金仙一一扫去，几人都纷纷点头，显然都同意赤精子所说的话！
眼见目的达成，赵公明便伸出手笑着说道：

“既然如此，那我也没有什么好说的了！那就先把清净琉璃瓶交给我吧！”
“啊？？？”
慈航道人都已经准备收取定海神珠了，没想到赵公明来这么一出！
content_en:
In Biyou Palace, Yuanshi Tianzun and Tongtian Cult Leader were seated in the palace respectively!
Looking at the situation in the space below, Yuanshi Tianzun said with some pride:
"These twenty-four Dinghai Divine Pearls are indeed very powerful innate spiritual treasures. Unfortunately, if we could collect all thirty-six of them, they might be able to reach the level of top-grade innate spiritual treasures, or even innate treasures! What a pity, what a pity..."
Leader Tongtian looked at the battle situation below with a somewhat uncertain expression. It looked like he was going to lose this round!
He doesn't understand how he can crack this game now!
But looking at Zhao Gongming's confident expression below, he doesn't seem worried?
Is it possible that these twenty-four Dinghai Divine Pearls still have some hidden abilities that they have not yet unleashed?
What ability can turn defeat into victory under the siege of so many three-light divine water?
If you are facing a normal enemy, there are many ways to avoid this three-light divine water!
But now it's just a battle of spirit treasures, but this pure glass bottle can generate three-light divine water, so it doesn't violate the rules!
Leader Tongtian looked at Lin Jing at this time. He had just taken Zhao Gongming out, and after he came back, he arranged for him to fight!
At this moment, Lin Jing didn't notice the Master's gaze at all!
He looked at the pure glass bottle and the three-light divine water in the space in front of him with an expression of obsession!
This water looks delicious! I really want to try it!
This pure glass vase also looks pretty. I don’t know if it has any intelligence. I’ll have to ask Senior Brother Zhao Gongming to borrow it later for training...
Speaking of which, this pure glass bottle and the three-light divine water mirror are also very familiar!
After all, there are famous plot descriptions in the famous works of previous lives!
A horse knocked down a ginseng fruit tree while fetching scriptures. Immortal Zhenyuan took care of it for a while. Finally, he asked Guanyin Bodhisattva to come and use the Three Lights Divine Water to revive the ginseng fruit tree!
Unexpectedly, this pure glass bottle will soon be in the hands of their Jie Jiao. I wonder if this Taoist Cihang will become a Bodhisattva after he rebels against the Western religion. After all, the classic magic weapons are gone...
Above the main hall, Chi Jingjing looked at the Dinghai Divine Pearl that had completely fallen into the disadvantage, and directly said sarcastically:
"Hmph! Senior Brother Gongming, the outcome of this game has obviously been decided. You are still unwilling to admit defeat. Could it be that you are reluctant to part with this innate spiritual treasure and want to cheat?"
Guangchengzi also said:
"This treasure fight was agreed upon by the two saints, Master and Third Uncle. Since Senior Brother Gongming has lost, he should admit it quickly! If our Chanjiao loses, we won't be so coy and the Lingbao will be given away generously!"
On Jie Jiao's side, all the disciples had expressions of embarrassment! When Sanxiao saw his eldest brother defeated, they all looked at each other angrily!
But now that the facts are here, it’s really hard to refute!
But then someone clapped loudly and said:
"Okay! Well said! I think it makes sense. We are all disciples of saints. We will definitely not keep our word. If we lose, we will hand over the spiritual treasure generously!"
As soon as these words came out, all the immortals turned their eyes away, but they didn't expect that it was Zhao Gongming who said this!
The Chanjiao people were obviously stunned, but after they realized what was happening, they were still overjoyed!
Originally, they were worried that Zhao Gongming would be unreasonable and unwilling to hand over the spiritual treasure, but they didn't expect that he would think so!
It seems that not all of these sects are ungrateful people, there are still good people!
Taoist Cihang also breathed a sigh of relief at this time. Most of the three-light divine water in this pure glass bottle was given by the master in advance, and very little belonged to her, so she felt very heartbroken every time she consumed it!
If Zhao Gongming still resists, not only will she suffer heavy losses, but the twenty-four Dinghai Divine Pearls will probably also be damaged a lot!
Now Taoist Cihang has regarded these twenty-four Dinghai Divine Pearls as possessions, and she is reluctant to harm her spiritual treasure!
At this time, Zhao Gongming saw that Taoist Cihang hadSome sadly said:
"Now that the outcome has been decided, let this be the case! Fellow Taoist Cihang, you should be willing to admit defeat in the upcoming treasure fight!"
Before Taoist Cihang opened his mouth, Chi Jingzheng couldn't wait to answer:
"Of course, if we lose the treasure fight, we will hand over the spirit treasure on the spot, and there will never be any delay!"
Zhao Gongming glanced at the Kunlun Golden Immortals one by one, and they all nodded, obviously agreeing with what Chi Jingjing said!
Seeing that his goal was achieved, Zhao Gongming stretched out his hand and said with a smile:
"In that case, I have nothing more to say! Then give me the pure glass bottle first!"
"Ah???"
Taoist Cihang was already preparing to collect the Dinghai Divine Pearl, but he didn't expect Zhao Gongming to show up like this!
